EVE's ice: fuel every structure burns forever, so the demand never stops. MB56a's shape with helium-3, Starfield's
own ship fuel. Same two stand-ins as MB56a (place.resource, beats[0].bring). Pay: med.

REWORKED 2026-11-10 (Eliza's 11-09 bring letter; OT-32 retired on his 10:07 ruling, 'limit the mission to a single planet where we know the resources are there'): bring.item is InorgCommonHelium3; the objective is short, no place and no count (the build appends (n/N)); pinned to Andromas III, which carries helium-3.

CARD 2026-11-10 (his 11-04 ruling, a posting by whoever set the job: no payer label, no payment line; his 11-10 'we still have all those X Contract things'). Was: "Private Contract. Deliver ten units of helium-3 to the <Place> on <Planet>. Payment on delivery."

LEVEL AND DISTANCE 2026-11-11 (his: 'some quests shouldnt be given to a level 1 player' and 'not sending them across the whole map just to deliver a coffee'; Eliza's minLevel and place.parsecs, FrankyCLI 3c81f6a): minLevel 15: pinned to Andromas III, a level-15 system.

OT-32, 2026-11-13 (his 11-12 'our ore missions don't seem to work on missonboards, changed them to remote', and ore1 played 11:48 'yup that worked'): a REMOTE Delve now, ore1's shape. POOL: the slate's remote-planet node (duo_MS_ArtifactMap_RemotePlanetNode), on its test node until he plays it: the job is pinned to a planet elsewhere, which is what that pool deals. FAMILY: Requisition (old MB02 to 04), on the closed list. No card (a slate has none) and no minLevel (board only); parsecs 50, as ore1.
UNPROVEN PLANET: Andromas III has had no startquest probe (his rule 11-12: prove a pinned planet before a recipe rests on it; Bolivar I failed). First play is the probe.
